name: Probe: start-alliance vision on the JAC Japan map 15 km (historical) - HOJO-IMAGAWA, SHIMAZU-RYUKYU, control DATE-SHIMAZU; gameplay and UI contexts, start and after 1 turn

steps.code: local function q(f) local ok,v=pcall(f); if ok then return tostring(v) end return 'ERR('..tostring(v)..')' end; local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName() or '','^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; local out={'ctx=GameCore_Tuner turn='..q(function() return Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() end), 'cfgAlliesShareVis='..q(function() return GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAME_ALLIES_SHARE_VISIBILITY') end), 'cfgNoTeams='..q(function() return GameConfiguration.GetValue('NO_TEAMS') end), 'allyVisionTraitInDb='..q(function() return GameInfo.Traits['TRAIT_JAC_1534_ALLY_VISION']~=nil end)}; for _,pr in ipairs({{'HOJO','IMAGAWA'},{'SHIMAZU','RYUKYU'},{'DATE','SHIMAZU'}}) do for _,d in ipairs({{pr[1],pr[2]},{pr[2],pr[1]}}) do local a,b=id[d[1]],id[d[2]]; if a==nil or b==nil then table.insert(out,d[1]..'>'..d[2]..' missing player') else local dip=Players[a]:GetDiplomacy(); local v=PlayersVisibility[a]; local cap=Players[b]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); local own=Players[a]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); table.insert(out,d[1]..'>'..d[2]..' state='..q(function() return GameInfo.DiplomaticStates[Players[a]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticStateIndex(b)].StateType end)..' hasAllied='..q(function() return dip:HasAllied(b) end)..' allianceType='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceType(b) end)..' allianceLevel='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceLevel(b) end)..' turnsLeft='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceTurnsUntilExpiration(b) end)..' partnerCap='..q(function() return cap:GetName() end)..' capVisible='..q(function() return v:IsVisible(cap:GetX(),cap:GetY()) end)..' capRevealed='..q(function() return v:IsRevealed(cap:GetX(),cap:GetY()) end)..' capVisCount='..q(function() return v:GetVisibilityCount(Map.GetPlot(cap:GetX(),cap:GetY()):GetIndex()) end)..' ownCapVisible='..q(function() return v:IsVisible(own:GetX(),own:GetY()) end)..' partnerPlotsSeen='..q(function() local vb=PlayersVisibility[b]; local n,m=0,0; for i=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do local pl=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i); if vb:IsVisible(pl:GetX(),pl:GetY()) then m=m+1; if v:IsVisible(pl:GetX(),pl:GetY()) then n=n+1 end end end; return n..'/'..m end)) end end end; local s=table.concat(out,' | '); print('[JAC_ALLY_VISION_PROBE] '..s); return s
